description: Reported 2016-17 Dodgers international signings with a bonus (Dodgers Digest, 2016-07-02 and 2017-07-04), matched by hand to MLBAM ids. Used by scripts/research/sources/intl-list-corroboration.mjs.

source.title: Dodgers sign Dominican SS Albert Suarez for $300,000
source.notes: "Suarez signed for a reported $300,000. The Dodgers have $2,118,900 to spend during this period, but they cannot spend more than $300,000 on any prospect." Repeated as $300,000 in the 2017-07-04 article.
